 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    rare = {c for c, n in counts.items() if n <= 0.1 * h * w}
    # Rare colors mark selected intersections; erase them while locating the lattice.
    clean = [[None if x in rare else x for x in row] for row in grid]

    def uniform_line(values):
        vals = [x for x in values if x is not None]
        if not vals:
            return None
        c, n = Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0]
        return c if n / len(vals) >= 0.95 else None

    row_colors = [uniform_line(row) for row in clean]
    col_colors = [uniform_line([clean[r][c] for r in range(h)]) for c in range(w)]
    # Separator rows/columns share the same non-marker color.
    line_votes = Counter(c for c in row_colors + col_colors if c is not None)
    line = line_votes.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [r for r, c in enumerate(row_colors) if c == line]
    cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(col_colors) if v == line]
    # Marked intersections are also guaranteed lattice coordinates.
    rows = sorted(set(rows) | {r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r][c] in rare for c in range(w))})
    cols = sorted(set(cols) | {c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] in rare for r in range(h))})
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x not in rare and x != line).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        outrow = []
